title: Entity ParticleOnHitSubcomponentDefinition
description: Emits a particle effect at the impact location, optionally only for entity hits or only for non-entity hits.

num_particles.title: Num Particles
num_particles.description: Number of particles to spawn per hit.

on_entity_hit.title: Entity Hit
on_entity_hit.description: If `true`, particles are spawned when the projectile hits an entity.

on_other_hit.title: Other Hit
on_other_hit.description: If `true`, particles are spawned when the projectile hits something that is not an entity.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

anyOf.description:
Properties:
• AND (object)
• NOT (object)
• OR (object)
• all (object)
• all_of (object)
• any (object)
• any_of (object)
• none_of (object)

AND.title: AND
AND.description: Evaluates all tests in the group, all must pass in order for the group to pass.

NOT.title: NOT
NOT.description: Evaluates all tests in the group, all must fail in order for the group to pass.

OR.title: OR
OR.description: Evaluates tests in the group, one or more must pass in order for the group to pass.

all.title: All
all.description: Evaluates all tests in the group, all must pass in order for the group to pass.

all_of.title: All Of
all_of.description: Evaluates all tests in the group, all must pass in order for the group to pass.

any.title: Any
any.description: Evaluates tests in the group, one or more must pass in order for the group to pass.

any_of.title: Any Of
any_of.description: Evaluates tests in the group, one or more must pass in order for the group to pass.

none_of.title: None Of
none_of.description: Evaluates all tests in the group, all must fail in order for the group to pass.

particle_item_name.description: Map from item identifier to a filter group, used to select an item icon for `iconcrack`-style particles based on context (e.g. the projectile's owner).

particle_type.title: Particle Type
particle_type.description: Particle type to spawn at the impact point.
